{{Quote|If we had some bruallki, we could have bruallki and Menkooro&mdash;''"<br />"''&mdash;if we had some Menkooro.|Talon Karrde and Aves|audio=WeCouldHaveBruallkiAndMenkooro-TheLastCommand.flac|<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Menkooro whiskey''',<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|306|Menkooro whiskey}}</ref> or simply '''Menkooro''',<ref name="The Last Command" /> was a [[Whiskey/Legends|type]] of [[Color|orange]]&ndash;colored<ref name="Dark Force Rising 6" />  [[Alcohol/Legends|bourbon]] that was considered the perfect accompaniment to [[bruallki]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]].<ref name="Jade Solitaire">{{StoryCite|story=Jade Solitaire|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> The two were part of an old saying that was sometimes used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] when they were seeking a solution to a problem.<ref name="The Last Command" /> 

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates events of both ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' and ''[[The Last Command]]'' to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> a crate containing bottles of Menkooro was in a storeroom on the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'', a luxury [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that operated in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]]. A [[Niles Ferrier's wraith|member]] of the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Species/Legends|species]] tracked the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to the ship. When an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] began [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|firing]] its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] at the ''Coral Vanda'' from Pantolomin's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], the crate of Menkooro was knocked open, spilling the whiskey onto the floor. Solo then used his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to ignite the Menkooro and was able to escape the Defel in the ensuing [[Fire/Legends|fire]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising" /> Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> smuggler [[Talon Karrde]] and his [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] [[Aves]] quoted the old saying while discussing the possibility that they had an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in their ranks.<ref name="The Last Command" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Menkooro whiskey first appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[1992]] novel ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'', the second book in the ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]''.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" /> It was first identified as simply "Menkooro" in the third book of ''The Thrawn Trilogy'', ''[[The Last Command]]'', also written by Zahn and released in [[1993]].<ref name="The Last Command" /> The whiskey was visually depicted in the [[Dark Force Rising 6|sixth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Dark Force Rising (comic series)|''Dark Force Rising'' comic adaptation]], which was released<ref name="Dark Force Rising 6" /> on [[October 29]], [[1997]]. The comic was written by [[Mike Baron]], illustrated by [[Terry Dodson]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54074/star_wars_dark_force_rising_1997_6|text=Star Wars: Dark Force Rising (1997) #6}}</ref>
